name: Berggasthof Wastler
beschreibung:
The Berggasthof Wastler is located in Thiersee, a valley village in the district of Kufstein in Tirol. The inn is in a quiet location at the entrance to the valley and can be reached both by car and on foot.

The kitchen offers regional specialties from Tirol and traditional dishes. Guests can choose between the cozy taproom and a small outdoor dining garden. The inn is ideal for day visitors and hikers who want to explore the surrounding mountain scenery.
